subject: renderUI not working between server.R and ui.R

messages.author: de0353bdfec15530
messages.subject: renderUI not working between server.R and ui.R
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am working on a Shiny app to plot an interactive heatmap of some data, which requires ui.R and server.R to share data.  Basically, the idea is, the user selects mouse strains and brain regions that they want to plot by selecting the strains and regions of interest using two checkboxGroupInputs -- one for the strains, and one for the regions.  The user then clicks on a button to recalculate and replot the heatmap using the selected strains and regions.  I want to create a UI where the checkboxGroupInput options depend on the data loaded in server.R (in other words, I don't want to hard code the row names and column names because I want to eventually extend this to be a generic heatmap app).  Basically, one checkboxGroupInput would have row names and the other checkboxGroupInput would have column names of the main server.R data set.  Here's how I've been doing it:

# server.R

library(gplots)

#creates a dataset of effect sizes for each mouse strain * region and creates a data frame called mousedata
source('helpers.R')
source('loaddata.R')
mousedata = alleffects(datadefs)
mousedatamat = as.matrix(mousedata)

shinyServer(
  function(input, output) {

    #renderUI is used to produce a dynamic UI
    output$regions <- renderUI({
      checkboxGroupInput(inputId = 'regions',
                         label = h3('Brain Regions'),
                         choices = colnames(mousedata),
                         selected = colnames(mousedata))
    })
    output$strains <- renderUI({
      checkboxGroupInput(inputId = 'strains',
                         label = h3('Mouse Strains'),
                         choices = rownames(mousedata),
                         selected = rownames(mousedata))
    })
   
    output$heatmap = renderPlot({
      # Take a dependency on input$recalculate
      input$recalculate
     
      # Use isolate() to avoid dependency on input$strains and input$regions
      mousedatamat = as.matrix(mousedata[isolate(input$strains), isolate(input$regions)])
      nr = dim(mousedatamat)[1]
      nc = dim(mousedatamat)[2]
     
#       if (length(isolate(input$strains)) >= 2 & length(isolate(input$regions)) >= 2) {
        heatmap.2(mousedatamat, distfun=jdfs, col=bluered, margins=c(8,14), trace="none", cexRow = 0.2 + 2/log10(nr), cexCol = 0.2 + 2/log10(nc), density.info="histogram", keysize=0.8, symkey=TRUE, symbreaks=TRUE)    
#       }
    })
  }
)

# ui.R

shinyUI(fluidPage(
 
  fluidRow(column(12, plotOutput(outputId = 'heatmap', height = "650px"))),
 
  hr(),
 
  fluidRow(
    column(4, uiOutput('strains')),
   
    column(4, uiOutput('regions')),
   
    column(4, actionButton('recalculate', 'Recalculate'))
  )
))

When I run the app, the error I get is:
Error in heatmap.2(mousedatamat, distfun = jdfs, col = bluered, margins = c(8,  :
  `x' must have at least 2 rows and 2 columns

It's like my server.R file doesn't understand how to get the selected checkboxes from input$strains or input$regions.  Any help would be greatly appreciated!

P.S. Another thought I had was defining mousedata in global.R, but I was wondering whether global.R runs before server.R or how that would work.

Cheers

messages.subject: Re: renderUI not working between server.R and ui.R
parts:
I've stumbled on another clue:

If I remove the isolate() calls in server.R surrounding input$strains and input$regions, then the heatmap is generated properly, but I don't want it to regenerate every time a checkbox is clicked.  There's a Recalculate button for that purpose.

This seems like a simple problem and there should be a simple solution for it.  The crux is that my UI elements depend on data in server.R, but then server.R depends on the values of those UI elements.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: renderUI not working between server.R and ui.R
parts:
Easiest thing to do is move mousedata to global.R. The code in global.R is guaranteed to run before either ui.R or server.R, and any variables it declares are accessible from either file. So then you can get rid of both uiOutputs and there should never be invalid values for input$strains or input$regions.

It also looks to me like you don't need the top-level `mousedatamat = as.matrix(mousedata)`, as this value is never read but always created as a local variable within the renderPlot code.

Just out of intellectual curiousity--or if for some other reason mousedata couldn't be moved to global.R--I bet you could do something like this at the top of your renderPlot:

if (is.null(isolate(input$strains))) {
  input$strains # take a dependency on input$strains
  validate(FALSE) # abort rendering this time
}
if (is.null(isolate(input$regions))) {
  input$regions # take a dependency on input$regions
  validate(FALSE) # abort rendering this time
}

This will cause renderPlot to retry each time input$strains / input$regions changes, but only until they both have values.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: renderUI not working between server.R and ui.R
parts: It's a subtle thing, but each time a renderXXX or reactive expression runs, it re-establishes its reactive dependencies from scratch. That is to say, at any given moment that output will rely on input$strain only if the *most recent invocation* of the output actually read input$strain (without isolate).
